title: Hinomori Shizuku — I'm Not Just Anyone, I'm "Me"〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thanks for coming, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You don't really need to thank us just for meeting.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I agree. So what did you need to talk about?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, before we get into that...
I was hoping to apologize to everyone.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm so sorry for all the trouble I caused everyone with our other video. I didn't mean to make you all worry so much.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: You don't have to apologize for that, Shizuku!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: You were just trying your hardest to show everyone the real you!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you, Minori. But that doesn't change the fact that I made everyone worry about me.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: So, I'm very sorry. Also...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you so much for believing in me enough to wait!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Shizuku...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Shizuku...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: In other words, you're trying to take responsibility. You really are too honest for your own good sometimes.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Still, that helped me clear my mind.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Minori, Airi, Haruka. I know I can be a handful...
But I hope you'll continue to have me.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Of course.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm just glad you came to a decision you're happy with.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Me too! Let's keep doing what we can, Shizuku!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Right!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Alright, can we get back to why we're here?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes. The truth is, I've been thinking about what to do for our next video and I wanted to get your opinions.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I apologize if it doesn't look very organized, but I just wrote down some thoughts in my notebook.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: One... Two... You have three whole pages?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You're really raring to go, aren't you?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Still, let's take a look at what you have. Which one of these was your favorite idea, Shizuku?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Well, let me see...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Discussing the best way to promote ourselves like this sure feels strange...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Up until now, I only ever had to follow whatever plans the agency came up with for me.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (It's thanks to them that the Shizuku Hinomori of Cheerful * Days was born and had so many adoring fans.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (But from now on, I want to be the real me. I want them to support me as Shizuku Hinomori of MORE MORE JUMP!)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: If I were to pick one, it would probably be the one where we each introduce our own personal techniques for practicing.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Our own techniques?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes. For example, Haruka always spends extra time making sure she properly stretches, yes?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Or how Airi and I have slightly different voice training methods and such.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I imagine there's a lot we don't know about one another's personal foibles when it comes to practicing alone, no?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: So we can watch videos of each other for the first time alongside the fans to show them our genuine reactions.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That would work since we stream our videos live. It might make it feel a little more like a concert too.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, that's true!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: If we do it this way, we can each have some dedicated time in the spotlight.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: And I think it'll be a particularly good way for the fans to learn more and more about Minori.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I think that's a great idea.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I want everyone to learn more and more about Minori as well.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Shizuku... Haruka...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I like it. And if we're doing something like stretching, the viewers can even do it with us.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It'll be a great way to encourage everyone to participate!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! Oh, I'd be really interested in seeing the voice training videos!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You do remember that you're making your own as well, right?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh! That's right!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. If Minori is this excited about it, I'm sure that means the fans will want to watch it as well.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I think so too.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! I'm sure they will!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Stretching and voice training with everyone?!
This is gonna be such a fun stream♪

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And thinking about this from the fans' perspective really is important. Anyways, let's get down to planning!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Right!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
(I hope this means I was of use to everyone.
Hehe. I'm actually starting to get excited myself.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I think this is the first time I've felt this way since becoming an idol.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I have no idea what the right thing to do is, but that isn't going to stop me from giving it my best.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (It's time to get everyone to support me as Shizuku Hinomori of MORE MORE JUMP!)
